description:
Figure 5 illustrates the performance scores for several datasets across different retrieval methods. The x-axis represents datasets, labeled as “TREC-COVID”, “BioASQ”, “NFCorpus”, “HotpotQA”, “Signal-IM (RT)”, “Robust04”, “ArgUana”, “Touché2020”, “CQADupStack”, “SciDQA”, “Climate-FEVER”, “TREC-NEWS”, “TREC-Total”, and “MS-Marco”, with tick labels at each dataset name. The x-axis is categorical. The y-axis represents performance scores, labeled as “ndcg@10”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, in increments of 10. 

There are eight lines displayed on the plot. The first line, colored blue and solid, represents “BERT”, starting at 64.9 for TREC-COVID and ending at 77.9 for CAPSTONE. The second line, colored orange and dashed, represents “LaPraDoR”, starting at 49.5 for TREC-COVID and ending at 74.0 for CAPSTONE. The third line, colored green and dotted, represents “SimCSE”, starting at 52.4 for TREC-COVID and ending at 75.4 for CAPSTONE. The fourth line, colored red and dash-dotted, represents “DHCSE”, starting at 49.2 for TREC-COVID and ending at 74.0 for CAPSTONE. The fifth line, colored purple and solid, represents “SEED”, starting at 61.2 for TREC-COVID and ending at 79.8 for CAPSTONE. The sixth line, colored brown and dashed, represents “Condenser”, starting at 41.5 for TREC-COVID and ending at 56.7 for CAPSTONE. The seventh line, colored teal and dotted, represents “coCondenser”, starting at 47.8 for TREC-COVID and ending at 77.9 for CAPSTONE. The eighth line, colored gray and solid, represents “CAPSTONE”, starting at 50.5 for TREC-COVID and ending at 80.3 for CAPSTONE.
